title: The Context Wall
visual_prompt: Cinematic 8k macro shot of a dark digital void where millions of translucent code lines (The Context Bloat) are stacking up into an insurmountable, glowing wall. The wall is flickering red, signaling 'Token Limit'. Suddenly, a sharp, clean neon-blue geometric pulse (C3) originates from the center, instantly slicing through the wall and leaving behind a perfectly clear path of organized code nodes. Particles of 'excess data' evaporate into blue sparks. Cyberpunk aesthetic, photorealistic.
camera_movement: Extreme slow-motion dolly zoom (Vertigo effect) into the red-flickering code wall, followed by a fast backward camera pull as the blue pulse clears the path.
sound_design: Low, oppressive glitchy digital hum that builds in tension. A crystalline 'shatter' sound as the pulse hits, transitioning into a pure, resonant electronic bell tone and airy wind.
